description.en:
Blocks or unblocks a player's Fighting Spirit for the match AI ("avater" is the game's spelling of avatar). It sets or clears a flag on the player's match data.
The only code found that reads the flag is the AI logic that decides when a team summons a Fighting Spirit: it leaves blocked players out.
The story matches block the opponent's Fighting Spirit users at kick-off, so the AI cannot summon early. They unblock them just before summoning in the scripted beat with CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER, and unblock them all again in their result callback.
Parameter ID of the player, e.g. "para_cp0150". Searched among all match players.
true to block, false to unblock.

true if the player was found and the flag changed, false if no match player has that ID.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Blocking the opponent's spirits at kick-off, releasing one for the story beat (real usage, from btl0007.nut)
